job.title: Liberty Bell Bay - Career Connector & RRSI Support Registration
job.description:
Liberty Bell Bay Employee - Rapid Response Skills Initiative & Career Connector Registration 
 
Register here for Career Connector support to:
 
Access the Rapid Response Skills Initiative (RRSI) that provides up to $3,000 of funding for Training, Work related tickets and Certification for workers that have been made redundant due to Retrenchment, Business Closure or Business Downsizing. 
 
This registration will also give you access to the Career Connector service that provides free personalised support to improve your employability and assist in your redeployment.  Career Connector is delivered by Searson Buck, on behalf of the Tasmanian Government, Jobs Tasmania.  
 
Career Connector provides:
  • Personalised career advice and support to help you secure your next role
  • A free job matching service connecting you with suitable employment opportunities
  • Access to up to $3,000 per person for training and re-skilling through the Rapid Response Skill Initiative for eligible redundant workers
  • Connections to the Network of Regional Jobs Hubs and a range of additional support services
To be eligible, you must meet all of the below criteria: 
  • have lost Casual, Full-time or Part-time work in the last 12 months due to Business Closure, Business Downsizing or Retrenchment
  • be an Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident with a Tasmanian Residential address
  • provide written evidence of job loss, redundancy or retrenchment (a Separation Certificate indicating Redundancy or Email/ Written Evidence of Redundancy)
  • If you were employed by Local, State or Australian Government or Government Department, Business or Government Enterprise, you may not be eligible for RRSI funded training.
